modes.raw: Raw TCP mode. Application payload is sent over a plain TCP connection.
modes.websocket: WebSocket mode over TCP. Payload is exchanged using WebSocket frames.
modes.http: HTTP request/response mode. Normal traffic uses /hello. Heartbeat uses GET /__hb?seq=&ts= (short-lived Connection: close).
modes.http-sse: HTTP Server-Sent Events (SSE) mode. Heartbeat is server-push only on GET /__hb/sse (text/event-stream). Normal traffic may run in parallel via /hello.

heartbeat_directions.client-only: Client initiates heartbeat messages (PING) and the server replies (PONG).
heartbeat_directions.server-only: Server initiates heartbeat messages/events and the client only monitors.
heartbeat_directions.bidirectional: Both client and server may initiate heartbeat messages. Use seq pairing; ts always means the sender's send time.

direction_constraints.http: For this project implementation, heartbeat.direction must be client-only on both client and server, otherwise the program exits.
direction_constraints.http-sse: For this project implementation, heartbeat.direction must be server-only on both client and server, otherwise the program exits.

ts_definition.rule: ts always represents the sender's send timestamp in milliseconds.
notes: RTT can only be computed when a request-response exchange exists (raw/websocket/http).
In http-sse mode, ts is the server send time used by the client to compute lag = now - ts.
